verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Alif-laam-meem
Ahasiban-naasu an yutrakoo an yaqooloo aamannaa wa hum laa yuftanoon
Wa laqad fatannal-ladheena min qablihim falaya'lamanna Allaahul-ladheena sadaqoo wa laya'lamannal-kaadhibeen
Am hasibal-ladheena ya'maloonas-sayyi'aati an yasbiqoonaa saa'a maa yahkumoon
Man kaana yarjoo liqaa'a Allaahi fa-inna ajala Allaahi la-aatin wa huwas-samee'ul-aleem
Wa man jaahada fa-innamaa yujaahidu linafsihi innallaaha laghaniyyun anil-aalameen
Wal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati lanukaffiranna anhum sayyi'aatihim wa lanajziyannahum ahsanal-ladhee kaanoo ya'maloon
Wa wassaynal-insaana biwaalidayhi husnan wa in jaahadaaka litushrika bee maa laysa laka bihi ilmun falaa tuti'humaa ilayya marji'ukum fa-unabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
Wal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati lanudkhilannahum fis-saaliheen

Wa minan-naasi man yaqoolu aamannaa Billaahi fa-idhaa oodhiya fee Allaahi ja'ala fitnatan-naasi ka'adhaabi Allaahi wa la-in jaa'a nasrun min rabbika layaqoolunna innaa kunnaa ma'akum awalaysa Allaahu bi-a'lama bimaa fee sudooril-aalameen
Wa laya'lamanna Allaahul-ladheena aamanoo wa laya'lamannal-munaafiqeen
Wa qaalal-ladheena kafaroo lilladheena aamanoo ittabi'oo sabeelanaa wa lnahmil khataayaakum wa maa hum bihaamileena min khataayaahum min shay'in innahum lakaadhiboon
Wa layahmilunna athqaalahum wa athqaalan ma'a athqaalihim wa layus'alunna yawmal-qiyaamati ammaa kaanoo yaftaroon
Wa laqad arsalnaa noohan ilaa qawmihi falabitha feehim alfa sanatin illaa khamseena aaman fa-akhadhahumut-toofaanu wa hum zaalimoon
Fa-anjaynaahu wa ashaabas-safeenati wa ja'alnaahaa aayatan lil-aalameen
Wa ibraaheema idh qaala liqawmihi u'budoo Allaaha wattaqoohu dhaalikum khayrun lakum in kuntum ta'lamoon

Innamaa ta'budoona min doonillaahi awthaanan wa takhluqoona ifkan innal-ladheena ta'budoona min doonillaahi laa yamlikoona lakum rizqan fabtaghoo indallaahir-rizqa wa'budoohu washkuroo lahu ilayhi turja'oon
Wa in tukadhdhiboo faqad kadhdhaba umamun min qablikum wa maa alar-rasooli illal-balaaghul-mubeen
Awalam yaraw kayfa yubdi'u Allaahul-khalqa thumma yu'eeduhu inna dhaalika alaa Allaahi yaseer
Qul seeroo fil-ardi fanzuroo kayfa bada'al-khalqa thumma Allaahu yunshi'un-nash'atal-aakhirata innallaaha alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Yu'adhdhibu man yashaa'u wa yarhamu man yashaa'u wa ilayhi tuqlaboon
Wa maa antum bimu'jizeena fil-ardi wa laa fis-samaa'i wa maa lakum min doonillaahi min waliyyin wa laa naseer
Wal-ladheena kafaroo bi-aayaati Allaahi wa liqaa'ihi ulaa'ika ya'isoo min rahmatee wa ulaa'ika lahum adhaabun aleem
Famaa kaana jawaaba qawmihi illaa an qaaluq-tuloohu aw harriqoohu fa-anjaahu Allaahu minan-naari inna fee dhaalika la-aayaatin liqawmin yu'minoon

Wa qaala innamaa ittakhadhtum min doonillaahi awthaanan mawaddata baynikum fil-hayaatid-dunyaa thumma yawmal-qiyaamati yakfuru ba'dukum biba'din wa yal-anu ba'dukum ba'dan wa ma'waakumun-naaru wa maa lakum min naasireen
Fa-aamana lahu lootun wa qaala innee muhaajirun ilaa rabbee innahu huwal-azeezul-hakeem
Wa wahabnaa lahu ishaaqa wa ya'qooba wa ja'alnaa fee dhurriyyatihin-nubuwwata wal-kitaaba wa aataynaahu ajrahu fid-dunyaa wa innahu fil-aakhirati laminas-saaliheen
Wa lootan idh qaala liqawmihi innakum lata'toonal-faahishata maa sabaqakum bihaa min ahadin minal-aalameen
A'innakum lata'toonar-rijaala wa taqta'oonas-sabeela wa ta'toona fee naadeekumul-munkara famaa kaana jawaaba qawmihi illaa an qaalu-tinaa bi-adhaabi Allaahi in kunta minas-saadiqeen
Qaala rabbi unsurnee alal-qawmil-mufsideen
Wa lammaa jaa'at rusulunaa ibraaheema bil-bushraa qaaloo innaa muhlikoo ahli haadhihil-qaryati inna ahlahaa kaanoo zaalimeen
Qaala inna feehaa lootan qaaloo nahnu a'lamu biman feehaa lanunajjiyannahu wa ahlahu illam-ra'atahu kaanat minal-ghaabireen
Wa lammaa an jaa'at rusulunaa lootan see'a bihim wa daaqa bihim dhar'an wa qaaloo laa takhaf wa laa tahzan innaa munajjooka wa ahlaka illam-ra'ataka kaanat minal-ghaabireen
Innaa munziloona alaa ahli haadhihil-qaryati rijzan minas-samaa'i bimaa kaanoo yafsuqoon
Wa laqad taraknaa minhaa aayatan bayyinatan liqawmin ya'qiloon
Wa ilaa madyana akhaahum shu'ayban faqaala yaa qawmi u'budoo Allaaha warjul-yawmal-aakhira wa laa ta'thaw fil-ardi mufsideen
Fakadhdhaboohu fa-akhadhathumur-rajfatu fa-asbahoo fee daarihim jaathimeen
Wa aadan wa thamooda wa qad tabayyana lakum min masaakinihim wa zayyana lahumush-shaytaanu a'maalahum fasaddahum anis-sabeeli wa kaanoo mustabsireen
Wa qaaroona wa fir'awna wa haamaana wa laqad jaa'ahum moosaa bil-bayyinaati fastakbaroo fil-ardi wa maa kaanoo saabiqeen

Fakullan akhadhnaa bidhanbihi faminhum man arsalnaa alayhi haasiban wa minhum man akhadhathus-sayhatu wa minhum man khasafnaa bihil-arda wa minhum man aghraqnaa wa maa kaana Allaahu liyazlimahum wa laakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon
Mathalul-ladheena ittakhadhoo min doonillaahi awliyaa'a kamathalil-ankabooti ittakhadhat baytan wa inna awhanal-buyooti labaytul-ankabooti law kaanoo ya'lamoon
Innallaaha ya'lamu maa yad'oona min doonihi min shay'in wa huwal-azeezul-hakeem
Wa tilkal-amthaalu nadribuhaa lin-naasi wa maa ya'qiluhaa illal-aalimoon
Khalaqa Allaahus-samaawaati wal-arda bil-haqqi inna fee dhaalika la-aayatan lilmu'mineen
Utlu maa oohiya ilayka minal-kitaabi wa aqimus-salaata innas-salaata tanhaa anil-fahshaa'i wal-munkari wa ladhikru Allaahi akbaru Wallaahu ya'lamu maa tasna'oon

Wa laa tujaadiloo ahlal-kitaabi illaa billatee hiya ahsanu illal-ladheena zalamoo minhum wa qooloo aamannaa billadhee unzila ilaynaa wa unzila ilaykum wa ilaahunaa wa ilaahukum waahidun wa nahnu lahu muslimoon
Wa kadhalika anzalnaa ilaykal-kitaaba fa-al-ladheena aataynaahumul-kitaaba yu'minoona bihi wa min haa'ulaa'i man yu'minu bihi wa maa yajhadu bi-aayaatinaa illal-kaafiroon
Wa maa kunta tatloo min qablihi min kitaabin wa laa takhuttuhu biyameenika idhan laartaabal-mubtiloon
Bal huwa aayaatun bayyinaatun fee sudooril-ladheena ootul-ilma wa maa yajhadu bi-aayaatinaa illaz-zaalimoon
Wa qaaloo lawlaa unzila alayhi aayaatun min rabbihi qul innamal-aayaatu indallaahi wa innamaa anaa nadheerun mubeen
Awalam yakfihim annaa anzalnaa alaykal-kitaaba yutlaa alayhim inna fee dhaalika larahmatan wa dhikraa liqawmin yu'minoon
Qul kafaa Billaahi baynee wa baynakum shaheedan ya'lamu maa fis-samaawaati wal-ardi wal-ladheena aamanoo bil-baatili wa kafaroo Billaahi ulaa'ika humul-khaasiroon
Wa yasta'jiloonaka bil-adhaabi wa lawlaa ajalun musamman lajaa'ahumul-adhaabu wa laya'tiyannahum baghtatan wa hum laa yash'uroon
Yasta'jiloonaka bil-adhaabi wa inna jahannama lamuheetatun bil-kaafireen
Yawma yaghshaahumul-adhaabu min fawqihim wa min tahti arjulihim wa yaqoolu dhooqoo maa kuntum ta'maloon
Yaa ibaadiyal-ladheena aamanoo inna ardee waasi'atun fa-iyyaaya fa'budoon
Kullu nafsin dhaa'iqatul-mawti thumma ilaynaa turja'oon
Wal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati lanubawwi'annahum minal-jannati ghurafan tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa ni'ma ajrul-aamileen
Al-ladheena sabaroo wa alaa rabbihim yatawakkaloon
Wa ka'ayyin min daabbatin laa tahmilu rizqahaa Allaahu yarzuquhaa wa iyyaakum wa huwas-samee'ul-aleem
Wa la-in sa'altahum man khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda wa sakhkharash-shamsa wal-qamara layaqoolunna Allaahu fa-annaa yu'ufakoon
Allaahu yabsutur-rizqa liman yashaa'u min ibaadihi wa yaqdiru lahu innallaaha bikulli shay'in aleem
Wa la-in sa'altahum man nazzala minas-samaa'i maa'an fa-ahyaa bihil-arda min ba'di mawtihaa layaqoolunna Allaahu qulil-hamdu Lillaahi bal aktharuhum laa ya'qiloon
Wa maa haadhihil-hayaatud-dunyaa illaa lahwun wa la-ibun wa innad-daaral-aakhirata lahiyal-hayawaanu law kaanoo ya'lamoon
Fa-idhaa rakiboo fil-fulki da'aw Allaaha mukhliseena lahud-deena falammaa najjaahum ilal-barri idhaa hum yushrikoon
Liyakfuroo bimaa aataynaahum wa liyatamatta'oo fasawfa ya'lamoon
Awalam yaraw annaa ja'alnaa haraman aaminan wa yutakhattafun-naasu min hawlihim afabiaalbaatili yu'minoona wa bini'mati Allaahi yakfuroon
Wa man azlamu mimmani iftaraa alaa Allaahi kadhiban aw kadhdhaba bil-haqqi lammaa jaa'ahu alaysa fee jahannama mathwan lilkaafireen
Wal-ladheena jaahadoo feenaa lanahdiyannahum subulanaa wa innallaaha lama'al-muhsineen
